title: Jacobi-Zariski homology sequence (Stacks Tag 00S2)
statement: For composable homomorphisms of commutative rings $A\to B\to C$, let $\mathrm{NL}_{B/A}$ and $H_1(L_{-/ -})$ have the canonical-presentation meaning in [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and let $\Omega$ mean the Kähler-differential module of [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. The Jacobi--Zariski sequence of **Stacks Tag 00S2 (lemma-exact-sequence-NL)** is exact as a sequence of $C$-modules: $$H_1(\mathrm{NL}_{B/A}\otimes_B C)\longrightarrow H_1(L_{C/A})\longrightarrow H_1(L_{C/B})\longrightarrow C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}\longrightarrow\Omega_{C/A}\longrightarrow\Omega_{C/B}\longrightarrow0.$$ Here each $L$ is computed from the polynomial-ring presentation used in the canonical naive cotangent-complex definition [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].
